title: Traumatic brain injury and concussion in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the head injury (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/22/2026
Reason for Admission: Traumatic brain injury following MVC.

Hospital Course:
Pt is a 75 y/o female admitted via EMS status post MVC. Initial presentation showed diffuse axonal injury. Pt was unconscious for three days prior to arrival. During hospitalization, pt was monitored for neurological status and stable vitals. Pt showed gradual improvement in cognitive function and returned to her usual level of consciousness. Stable RRR, CTAB, and WNL on physical exam. Neuro exams showed improvement in orientation and motor skills. No acute distress noted. Transitioned to rehab for physical and occupational therapy.

Discharge Diagnoses:
1. Diffuse axonal injury
2. Traumatic brain injury

Discharge Medications:
- Gabapentin 300mg BID
- Meloxicam 15mg QD

Follow-up:
F/u with neurology in 1 week for neuro assessment. F/u with PT/OT daily.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, MD
05/22/2026
explanations: Diffuse traumatic brain injury with loss of consciousness over 24 hours and return to the prior conscious level, initial encounter: S06.2X5A (HCC 397).

hccs.label: Major Head Injury with Loss of Consciousness > 1 Hour
